description: Free-tier endpoint. Every NBA, NFL or NHL lineup change over the last 1-90 days, newest first: old_role -> new_role and old_status -> new_status with the time we saw it (old_role null = first listed, new_role null = dropped from the lineup). History starts 2026-11-22. Pair with odds history to see how lines moved on a lineup change.
name: propline_get_lineup_history
title: Get lineup changes
